lines: Highlight on hover
Highlight shapes when hovering them with the mouse.
Auto expand layers
When set auto-expands the layer tree for the current selection.
Enable auto-save
Files are saved automatically - please choose the interval (minutes) on the right. Please note that this feature is only available for files saved or synced to Gravit Designer.
Auto-save: Warning for unsaved/local files
Show warning to remind about saving/syncing files to Gravit Designer to enable auto-save.
Change the theme of Gravit Designer
Light Theme (default)
Left-aligned icons in the toolbar.
Save text layers as paths
Saving paths will increase the file size but not require the fonts to be available.
Rounding
Please switch on to be able to define the number of decimal places where values are rounded in input fields.
Disable warning messages of unsupported features
Whether to disable warning message about unsupported features on svg exporter or not.
Outline fonts in EPS import
Fonts will be outlined so that they are not required to display the file correctly. Switch off to keep font information and edit text layers.
Disable notifications
Stop receiving email notifications for new comments or annotations (can be changed for every design individually in the comments panel).
Disable changing values in numeric input fields with dragging.
